query: Chemically defined differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into peripheral sensory neurons and nociceptors
title: Derivation of Peripheral Nociceptive, Mechanoreceptive, and Proprioceptive Sensory Neurons from the same Culture of Human Pluripotent Stem Cells
markdown:
## Protocol: Chemically defined differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into peripheral sensory neurons and nociceptors

### Overview

This protocol outlines the chemically defined differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) into peripheral sensory neurons and nociceptors. The process begins with hPSC maintenance on vitronectin-coated dishes, followed by neural crest cell induction using specific small molecule inhibitors (SB431542, CHIR99021, SU5402, DAPT). Cells are then replated onto poly-L-ornithine/laminin/fibronectin-coated surfaces and maintained in a neurobasal-based medium supplemented with neurotrophins (GDNF, BDNF, NGF) and retinoic acid. Optional steps include fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) or panning for TRKA/TRKB/TRKC-positive cells to enrich for specific neuronal subtypes.

### Materials/Reagents

- Essential 8 Medium (E8) + Supplement
- Essential 6 Medium (E6)
- Vitronectin (5 μg/mL)
- Geltrex (1:100 dilution)
- EDTA solution (0.5 mM in PBS with 3.08 M NaCl)
- Accutase
- Phosphate-buffered saline (PBS)
- SB431542 (10 μM)
- CHIR99021 (1.5 μM, 0.75 μM, or 300 nM)
- Y-27632 (10 μM)
- Bone morphogenetic protein 4 (BMP4, 1 ng/mL)
- SU5402 (2.5 μM)
- DAPT (2.5 μM or 1 μM)
- Poly-L-ornithine hydrobromide (15 μg/mL)
- Mouse laminin-1 (2 μg/mL)
- Human fibronectin (2 μg/mL)
- Neurobasal medium
- N2 supplement
- B-27 supplement
- L-glutamine (2 mM)
- Glial cell line-derived neurotrophic factor (GDNF, 20 ng/mL)
- Brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF, 20 ng/mL)
- Nerve growth factor (NGF, 25 ng/mL)
- Neurotrophin-3 (NT-3, 20 ng/mL)
- Retinoic acid (0.125 μM)
- Flow buffer (DMEM, 2% FBS, 1 mM L-glutamine)
- Sterile water
- Anti-mouse IgG or anti-goat IgG
- Tris-HCl (50 mM, pH 9.5)
- TRKA, TRKB, or TRKC antibodies
- Bovine serum albumin (BSA, 0.2%)
- DNAse (10 μg)
- Panning buffer (20% FBS, 10 μg DNAse, 10 μM Y-27632 in PBS)
- Dissociation buffer (1 mL Accutase in 14 mL 1× Earle's balanced salt solution)

### Equipment

- Cell culture incubator (37°C, 5% CO2)
- Coated tissue culture plates/dishes
- Micropipettes (p1000)
- 0.22-μm filter
- Centrifuge

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile technique throughout all procedures. Use appropriate personal protective equipment when handling chemicals such as DMSO-soluble inhibitors and biological reagents. Ensure all solutions are prepared under aseptic conditions where applicable.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-differentiation coating

1. Prior to differentiation, coat plates with Geltrex diluted 1:100 and store at 4°C overnight, or use vitronectin coating. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Prepare NCC D2+ medium by adding 10 μM SB431542 and either 1.5 μM or 0.75 μM CHIR99021 to Essential 6 Medium (E6). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
3. For sensory neuron (SN) induction, maintain cells in D2-12 medium consisting of E6 supplemented with 10 μM SB431542, 0.75 μM CHIR99021, 2.5 μM SU5402, and 2.5 μM DAPT. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
4. On day 12, replate cells at a density of 250,000 cells/cm² onto plates coated with 15 μg/mL poly-L-ornithine hydrobromide, 2 μg/mL mouse laminin-1, and 2 μg/mL human fibronectin (PO/LM/FN). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
5. Dissociate cells with Accutase for 20 minutes, wash with PBS, and resuspend in SN medium: neurobasal medium containing N2, B-27, 2 mM L-glutamine, 20 ng/mL GDNF, 20 ng/mL BDNF, 25 ng/mL NGF, 600 ng/mL laminin-1 and fibronectin, 1 μM DAPT, and 0.125 μM retinoic acid. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
6. Dissociate cells with Accutase for 20 minutes and wash them in Flow buffer composed of DMEM, 2% fetal bovine serum (FBS), and 1 mM L-glutamine. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->
7. Prepare hypo-osmotic medium by mixing SN medium with sterile water in a 45:55 ratio. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S07 -->
8. Coat three 10-cm Petri dishes with 40 μL of anti-mouse immunoglobulin G (IgG) or anti-goat IgG in 13 mL of 50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 9.5) and incubate at 4°C overnight. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S08 -->
9. Wash the dishes three times with PBS and incubate with 6.6 μg of TRKA, TRKB, or TRKC antibody in 5 mL of 0.2% BSA + 10 μg DNAse in PBS for at least 2 hours at room temperature. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S09 -->
10. Resuspend the cell pellet in Panning buffer (20% FBS, 10 μg of DNAse, and 10 μM Y-27632 in PBS) using a p1000 micropipette, pass through a 0.22-μm filter, and count the cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S10 -->
11. Incubate the dish with 5 mL of dissociation buffer (1 mL of Accutase in 14 mL of 1× Earle's balanced salt solution) at 37°C for 5 minutes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S11 -->

## hPSC Maintenance

### Maintenance

1. Grow human embryonic stem cells (WA-09, WiCell) at 37°C/5% CO₂ and feed daily with Essential 8 Medium (E8) + Supplement on dishes coated with vitronectin (5 μg/mL, incubated for 1 hour at room temperature). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. For splitting H9 colonies, wash with PBS and treat with 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS with 3.08 M NaCl for 2 minutes at 37°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
3. Resuspend cells in E8 + Supplement and split at a ratio of 1:10. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->

## Neural Crest and Sensory Neuron Differentiation

### Day 0

1. The next day, harvest hPSCs using EDTA for 15 minutes and plate them at a density of 200,000 cells/cm². [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. From day 0 (day of plating) to day 1 of differentiation, feed cultures with Essential 6 Medium (E6) containing 10 μM SB431542, 1 ng/mL bone morphogenetic protein 4, 300 nM CHIR99021, and 10 μM Y-27632. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->

### Day 2

1. On day 2, prepare NCC D2+ medium with E6 containing 10 μM SB431542 and 1.5 μM or 0.75 μM CHIR99021. For sensory neuron induction, maintain cells in D2-12 medium (E6 + 10 μM SB431542, 0.75 μM CHIR99021, 2.5 μM SU5402, and 2.5 μM DAPT). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->
2. Feed cells every 48 hours between day 2 and day 12. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S02 -->

### Day 12

1. On day 12, replate cells at a density of 250,000 cells/cm² onto plates coated with 15 μg/mL poly-L-ornithine hydrobromide, 2 μg/mL mouse laminin-1, and 2 μg/mL human fibronectin (PO/LM/FN). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S01 -->
2. Dissociate cells with Accutase for 20 minutes, wash with PBS, and resuspend in SN medium: neurobasal medium containing N2, B-27, 2 mM L-glutamine, 20 ng/mL GDNF, 20 ng/mL BDNF, 25 ng/mL NGF, 600 ng/mL laminin-1 and fibronectin, 1 μM DAPT, and 0.125 μM retinoic acid. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S02 -->
3. Add NT-3 (20 ng/mL) where indicated. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S03 -->
4. Feed cells every 2–3 days through day 20. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S04 -->

### Day 20

1. On day 20, remove DAPT and feed cells every 3–4 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T3-S01 -->
